steps: 1. Open the Login page

2. Observe the credentials/help area on the page

test_cases.test_case: Username required - leave Username blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating "Epic sadface: Username is required."; the form does not submit; no redirect to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Password required - leave Password blank and submit
steps: 1. Enter standard_user in the Username field
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating "Epic sadface: Password is required."; the form does not submit; no redirect to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: All required fields empty - submit with both Username and Password blank
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Username field displays inline error "Epic sadface: Username is required." and Password field displays inline error "Epic sadface: Password is required."; the form does not submit; no redirect to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Invalid username - username not in accepted_usernames with correct shared password
steps: 1. Enter <username not in accepted_usernames> in the Username field
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service."; the form does not submit; no redirect to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Invalid password - accepted username with non-shared password
steps: 1. Enter standard_user in the Username field
2. Enter <password not equal to secret_sauce> in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service."; the form does not submit; no redirect to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Locked out user - locked_out_user cannot log in even with shared password
steps: 1. Enter locked_out_user in the Username field
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out."; the form does not submit; user remains on the Login page and is not redirected to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Very long Username (>200 chars) with valid shared password
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (>200 characters) in the Username field
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Login is blocked; an error banner displays: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service." (the long Username is not in the accepted_usernames list)

test_cases.test_case: Username containing emoji / non‑ASCII characters with valid shared password
steps: 1. Enter a Username value containing emoji and non-ASCII Unicode characters (e.g. characters outside ASCII) in the Username field
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Login is blocked; an error banner displays: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service." (the Unicode/emoji Username is not in the accepted_usernames list)

test_cases.test_case: Username with leading and trailing whitespace and valid shared password
steps: 1. Enter the accepted Username value surrounded by leading and trailing whitespace in the Username field (e.g. " <accepted_username> ")
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Login is blocked; an error banner displays: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service." (username + whitespace does not match an accepted_username exactly)

test_cases.test_case: After successful login, press browser Back and submit with empty fields
steps: 1. Enter standard_user in the Username field
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
3. Click the Login button
4. Observe redirect to the Product Inventory page
5. Press the browser Back button
6. Click the Login button without entering any values
test_cases.expected_result: After pressing Back the Login form is displayed blank; the subsequent submit is blocked and both required field errors are shown: "Epic sadface: Username is required." and "Epic sadface: Password is required."

steps: 1. Open the Product Inventory page
2. Click 'Remove' on the Product_Row_Action_Bar for <product>
test_cases.expected_result: Button label toggles to 'Add to cart' for <product>; Cart_Badge shows '0'

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price (Low–High) orders list ascending by price
preconditions: Product list contains at least two products with different prices
steps: 1. Open the Product Inventory page
2. Select 'Price (Low–High)' from the Sort_Dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Products list displays items ordered by Price ascending; the product with the lower price appears above the product with the higher price

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name (A–Z) orders list alphabetically
preconditions: Product list contains at least two products with distinct names
steps: 1. Open the Product Inventory page
2. Select 'Name (A–Z)' from the Sort_Dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Products list displays items in alphabetical order (A–Z); a product whose name is earlier alphabetically appears above one that is later

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated access to Product Inventory page is blocked
steps: 1. Open the Product Inventory page URL in the browser while not logged in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Login page; the Product Inventory listing is not shown (no product rows, no Sort_Dropdown, no Cart_Badge).

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated access to Product Detail page is blocked
preconditions: A product exists with a Detail page
steps: 1. Open the Product Detail page URL for <a product> while not logged in
2. (Alternative UI) On the Product Inventory page, click the <Product_Name> link while not logged in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Login page; the Product Detail page content is not displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt 'Remove' action when product state is NotInCart (wrong-state action)
preconditions: There is a product currently in the NotInCart state
steps: 1. Log in as a valid user
2. Open the Product Inventory page
3. Locate <a product currently in NotInCart state> in the product list
4. Attempt to click a 'Remove' button in that product's row (search for a 'Remove' control and click it if present)
test_cases.expected_result: No 'Remove' button is visible for that product row; clicking has no effect. Product state remains NotInCart; Cart_Badge.value remains unchanged.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt 'Add to cart' action when product state is already InCart (wrong-state action)
preconditions: There is a product currently in InCart state (e.g., added previously)
steps: 1. Log in as a valid user
2. Open the Product Inventory page
3. Locate <a product currently in InCart state> in the product list
4. Attempt to click an 'Add to cart' button in that product's row (search for an 'Add to cart' control and click it if present)
test_cases.expected_result: No 'Add to cart' button is visible for that product row; clicking has no effect. Product state remains InCart; Cart_Badge.value remains unchanged.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click 'Add to cart' on same product row
preconditions: Target product row is in NotInCart state (button label 'Add to cart')
steps: 1. On the Product Inventory page, locate the target product row
2. Click the 'Add to cart' button on that product row
3. Immediately click the 'Add to cart' button on the same product row a second time (within a short burst)
test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds: Cart_Badge.value increments by 1 relative to baseline, the product row button label changes to 'Remove', and the product state updates to InCart. The second immediate click is ignored (does not increment Cart_Badge again); Cart_Badge.value remains incremented by 1 and the button remains 'Remove'.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click 'Remove' on same product row (prevent double-decrement)
preconditions: Target product row is in InCart state (button label 'Remove')
steps: 1. On the Product Inventory page, locate the target product row
2. Click the 'Remove' button on that product row
3. Immediately click the 'Remove' button on the same product row a second time (within a short burst)
test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds: Cart_Badge.value decrements by 1, the product row button label changes to 'Add to cart', and the product state updates to NotInCart. The second immediate click is ignored; Cart_Badge.value remains at the decremented value and does not go below zero. No negative badge value occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly add two different products to cart from the list
preconditions: Two distinct product rows A and B are in NotInCart state (button label 'Add to cart')
steps: 1. On the Product Inventory page, locate product row A
2. Click 'Add to cart' on product row A
3. On the Product Inventory page, locate product row B
4. Click 'Add to cart' on product row B
test_cases.expected_result: Both clicks succeed: Cart_Badge.value increments by 2 relative to baseline, product row A and product row B button labels each change to 'Remove', and both product states update to InCart. No duplicate increments for the same row occur.

test_cases.test_case: Add to cart, navigate to Product Detail, then return — cart state persistence
preconditions: Target product row is in NotInCart state
steps: 1. On the Product Inventory page, locate the target product row
2. Click the 'Add to cart' button on that product row
3. Click the product name link on the same row to navigate to the Product Detail page
4. Use the browser Back action (or application back control) to return to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: The Add action succeeds before navigation: Cart_Badge.value increments by 1 relative to baseline and the product row button label is 'Remove'. After returning, the Product Inventory page shows the same product row with button label 'Remove' and Cart_Badge.value remains incremented by 1. No duplicate items are created and the product state remains InCart.

test_cases.test_case: Immediate Add then Remove on same product (rapid state flip-flop)
preconditions: Target product row is in NotInCart state
steps: 1. On the Product Inventory page, locate the target product row
2. Click the 'Add to cart' button on that product row
3. Immediately click the 'Remove' button on the same product row
test_cases.expected_result: Both state transitions succeed sequentially: the Add to cart action increments Cart_Badge.value by 1 and changes the button to 'Remove'; the subsequent Remove action decrements Cart_Badge.value back to baseline and changes the button to 'Add to cart'. Final product state is NotInCart and Cart_Badge.value equals baseline. No intermediate negative or duplicate counts occur.

test_cases.test_case: Very long product name rendering in list and detail views (>200 characters)
preconditions: There exists a product whose Product_Name length > 200 characters
steps: 1. On the Product Inventory page, locate the product row with the very long Product_Name
2. Observe how the Product_Name is rendered in the Products_List row
3. Click the Product_Name link to navigate to the Product Detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Rendering behavior is visible and usable: the Products_List row truncates the very long Product_Name with an on-screen indication (e.g., ellipsis) and does not break the table layout, and clicking the Product_Name link succeeds in navigating to the Product Detail page where the full Product_Name is displayed in full. No UI overlap or loss of the row occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Product name/description containing emoji and Unicode characters
preconditions: There exists a product whose Product_Name or Description contains emoji and non-ASCII Unicode characters
steps: 1. On the Product Inventory page, locate the product row with emoji / Unicode in Product_Name or Description
2. Observe the Product_Name and Description rendering in the row
3. Click the Product_Name link to navigate to the Product Detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Unicode and emoji render visibly without truncation or replacement characters; clicking the Product_Name link succeeds and navigates to the Product Detail page where the emoji and Unicode characters are displayed correctly. No errors are shown and Cart_Badge is unaffected by viewing.

test_cases.test_case: View Product Detail displays image, name, description and price
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Detail page for <product>
test_cases.expected_result: Product image, name, description, and price are visible on the Product Detail page

test_cases.test_case: Add to cart button appears and switches to 'Remove' after clicking when product is not in cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Detail page for <product>
2. Verify the 'Add to cart' button is visible
3. Click the 'Add to cart' button
test_cases.expected_result: Button label changes to 'Remove', indicating the product is in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Remove button appears and switches to 'Add to cart' after clicking when product is in cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Detail page for <product>
2. Verify the 'Remove' button is visible
3. Click the 'Remove' button
test_cases.expected_result: Button label changes to 'Add to cart', indicating the product is not in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Back to products link redirects to Product Inventory page
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Detail page for <product>
2. Click the 'Back to products' link
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Cart Icon navigates to Shopping Cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Detail page for <product>
2. Click the 'Cart Icon'
test_cases.expected_result: navigates to Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to Remove when product is Not In Cart (Remove action not available)
preconditions: User is on the Product Detail page for <product>
<product> is in state 'Not In Cart' (not present in the Shopping Cart)
steps: 1. Open the Product Detail page for <product>
2. Locate the action area where 'Add to cart' / 'Remove' button is shown
3. Look for a 'Remove' button
4. If a 'Remove' button is present, attempt to click the 'Remove' button
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Remove' button is not visible / not present on the page (the UI does not offer a Remove action when the product is 'Not In Cart'); attempting to invoke Remove is not possible; the Shopping Cart contents remain unchanged and <product> remains in state 'Not In Cart'.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to Add to cart when product is already In Cart (Add action not available)
preconditions: User is on the Product Detail page for <product>
<product> is in state 'In Cart' (already present in the Shopping Cart)
steps: 1. Open the Product Detail page for <product>
2. Locate the action area where 'Add to cart' / 'Remove' button is shown
3. Look for an 'Add to cart' button
4. If an 'Add to cart' button is present, attempt to click the 'Add to cart' button
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Add to cart' button is not visible / not present on the page (the UI does not offer Add to cart when the product is already 'In Cart'); attempting to invoke Add to cart is not possible; the Shopping Cart contents remain unchanged (no duplicate entry is created) and <product> remains in state 'In Cart'.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click Add to cart results in a single cart entry
preconditions: User is on the Product Detail page for a product that is not in the cart (button shows "Add to cart")
Shopping Cart is empty of this product
steps: 1. Click the "Add to cart" button
2. Immediately (within one second) click the "Add to cart" button again
3. Click the Cart Icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: The first Add action succeeds and the second rapid click is ignored; the product appears exactly once in the Shopping Cart list and the Product Detail button shows "Remove" when revisited (no duplicate entry).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive Add then Remove transitions end in consistent final state
preconditions: User is on the Product Detail page for a product that is not in the cart (button shows "Add to cart")
Shopping Cart is empty of this product
steps: 1. Click the "Add to cart" button
2. As soon as the button label changes to "Remove", click the "Remove" button
3. Click the Cart Icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: Sequential state transitions succeed; final state is Not In Cart: the product does not appear in the Shopping Cart and the Product Detail page shows "Add to cart" (no residual/inconsistent entry).

test_cases.test_case: Add to cart then immediately navigate Back to products before add confirmation completes
preconditions: User is on the Product Detail page for a product that is not in the cart (button shows "Add to cart")
Shopping Cart is empty of this product
steps: 1. Click the "Add to cart" button
2. Immediately click the "Back to products" link
3. From the Product Inventory page, click the Cart Icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: The Add action succeeds in background despite immediate navigation; the product appears in the Shopping Cart (single entry) and revisiting the Product Detail shows the button as "Remove".

test_cases.test_case: Return to Product Detail via browser back/forward and attempt second Add is blocked
preconditions: User adds the product to cart successfully (Product Detail now shows "Remove")
User navigates back to Product Inventory, then uses browser Back to return to the Product Detail page
steps: 1. On the Product Detail page (after a successful add), click the Back to products link
2. Use the browser Back control to return to the Product Detail page
3. Click the "Add to cart" button again
test_cases.expected_result: The original Add succeeds; the second Add attempt is blocked / error shown (no duplicate entry). Shopping Cart contains only the single originally added product and the Product Detail button remains in the correct state reflecting a single cart entry.

test_cases.test_case: Click Add to cart then refresh the Product Detail page immediately
preconditions: User is on the Product Detail page for a product that is not in the cart (button shows "Add to cart")
Shopping Cart is empty of this product
steps: 1. Click the "Add to cart" button
2. Immediately refresh/reload the Product Detail page
3. Click the Cart Icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: The Add action succeeds despite the refresh; the Shopping Cart shows the product (single entry) and the Product Detail page after reload shows the button as "Remove" (no duplicate entries or lost add).

test_cases.test_case: Remove an item from the cart via row Remove action
steps: 1. Navigate to the Shopping Cart page
2. Locate the row for <cart item> in the Cart Items table
3. Click the Remove button for <cart item>
test_cases.expected_result: The Cart Items table no longer displays a row with description <cart item>; any remaining cart items remain listed

test_cases.test_case: Use Continue Shopping to return to Product Inventory
steps: 1. Navigate to the Shopping Cart page
2. Click the 'Continue Shopping' link in the page action bar
test_cases.expected_result: Product Inventory page is displayed with the product listing visible (navigated to Product Inventory)

test_cases.test_case: Begin checkout by clicking Checkout on the cart page
steps: 1. Navigate to the Shopping Cart page
2. Click the 'Checkout' button in the page action bar
test_cases.expected_result: The Checkout page is displayed indicating the checkout flow has begun

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user cannot access Shopping Cart page
steps: 1. In a new browser session where no user is signed in, navigate to the <Shopping Cart page URL>
test_cases.expected_result: The application prevents access to the Shopping Cart: the user is redirected to the Login page (Login page is displayed and prompts for credentials) and the Shopping Cart content is not shown; the cart is not accessible without signing in.

test_cases.test_case: 'Continue Shopping' link does not navigate to Product Inventory (broken link)
preconditions: Shopping Cart contains at least one item
steps: 1. Open the <Shopping Cart page URL> while signed in
2. Click the 'Continue Shopping' link in the Cart Page Actions
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking 'Continue Shopping' does not navigate to Product Inventory: the browser remains on the Shopping Cart page (URL remains <Shopping Cart page URL>), the Shopping Cart content remains visible, and no Product Inventory page is loaded (i.e., no navigation occurs).

test_cases.test_case: Double-click / repeated Remove on the same cart row (idempotence)
preconditions: User is on the Shopping Cart page
Cart contains at least one item
steps: 1. Locate the Cart_Items_Table row for a specific item
2. Click the row's Remove button
3. Immediately attempt to click the same row's Remove button again (within 1 second)
test_cases.expected_result: First Remove click succeeds: the item's row disappears from Cart_Items_Table and the visible row count decrements. Second attempt is blocked: the Remove control for that removed row is not present/clickable (no additional removal occurs) and no duplicate removal action is performed.

test_cases.test_case: Remove the last item, then attempt Checkout
preconditions: User is on the Shopping Cart page
steps: 1. Click the Remove button for the lone item in the Cart_Items_Table
2. Click the Checkout button in the Cart_Page_Actions area
test_cases.expected_result: Remove click succeeds: the cart becomes empty and Cart_Items_Table shows no rows. Checkout click is blocked / error shown: Checkout does not begin; the UI indicates checkout cannot proceed for an empty cart (Checkout button disabled or a visible inline message explaining cart is empty).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click Checkout to check duplicate checkout prevention
preconditions: User is on the Shopping Cart page
Cart contains at least one item
steps: 1. Click the Checkout button in the Cart_Page_Actions area
2. Immediately click the Checkout button again (within 1 second)
test_cases.expected_result: First Checkout click succeeds: the app begins checkout and navigates to the checkout flow. Second click is blocked: no second navigation or duplicate checkout flow is started; only one checkout process is initiated and only one navigation occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Very long product description rendering in cart (200+ characters)
preconditions: A product with a description length of at least 200 characters exists in Product Inventory
That product has been added to the cart and user is on the Shopping Cart page
steps: 1. Open the Shopping Cart page
2. Locate the description cell for the long-description item in Cart_Items_Table
test_cases.expected_result: Long-description handling succeeds: the Cart_Items_Table displays the item's description without breaking page layout. If the UI truncates the description, the cell shows a visible truncation indicator (ellipsis) and the full text is accessible via the UI affordance; if the UI wraps the text, no horizontal overflow or layout break occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Continue with all required fields filled navigates to Overview step
preconditions: Checkout - Information page is open with First Name, Last Name and Postal Code fields visible
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid postal code> in the Postal Code field
4. Click the Continue button
test_cases.expected_result: Overview step is displayed (the Checkout Overview screen is visible to the user)

test_cases.test_case: Cancel from Information step returns user to Shopping Cart
steps: 1. Click the Cancel button
test_cases.expected_result: Shopping Cart page is displayed (user is returned to the Shopping Cart)

test_cases.test_case: Leave representative required text field (First Name) blank and submit
preconditions: User is on the Checkout - Information page
steps: 1. Ensure the First Name field is blank
2. Enter <valid last name> into the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid postal/zip code> into the Postal Code field
4. Click the Continue button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First Name field indicating it is required; an error banner displays "Error: First Name is required"; the form does not proceed to the overview step and the user remains on the Checkout - Information page

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all required fields empty
preconditions: User is on the Checkout - Information page
steps: 1. Ensure the First Name field is blank
2. Ensure the Last Name field is blank
3. Ensure the Postal Code field is blank
4. Click the Continue button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on the First Name, Last Name, and Postal Code fields and an error banner displays the messages "Error: First Name is required", "Error: Last Name is required", and "Error: Postal Code is required"; the form does not proceed to the overview step and the user remains on the Checkout - Information page

test_cases.test_case: Whitespace-only values in required fields are treated as empty and blocked
preconditions: User is on the Checkout - Information form
steps: 1. Focus the First_Name field
2. Enter <a single space character> in First_Name
3. Focus the Last_Name field
4. Enter <a single space character> in Last_Name
5. Focus the Postal_Code field
6. Enter <a single space character> in Postal_Code
7. Click the Continue button
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is blocked; an error banner and inline field errors are shown. The banner and/or inline messages include the exact text: "Error: First Name is required", "Error: Last Name is required", and "Error: Postal Code is required"

test_cases.test_case: Very long First_Name and Last_Name (200+ characters) handling
preconditions: User is on the Checkout - Information form
steps: 1. Enter <very long string (200+ characters)> in First_Name
2. Enter <very long string (200+ characters)> in Last_Name
3. Enter <a non-empty value> in Postal_Code
4. Click the Continue button
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission succeeds; the app proceeds to the overview step and the overview displays the saved First_Name and Last_Name containing the full entered strings (no visible truncation). If the UI enforces a max-length instead, a visible inline error or truncation indicator is shown before navigation

test_cases.test_case: Special characters and emoji in name fields
preconditions: User is on the Checkout - Information form
steps: 1. Enter <special characters and emoji> in First_Name
2. Enter <special characters and emoji> in Last_Name
3. Enter <a non-empty value> in Postal_Code
4. Click the Continue button
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission succeeds; the app proceeds to the overview step and the overview displays the saved First_Name and Last_Name including the entered special characters/emoji (no stripping or replacement shown). If the system rejects those characters, an inline error is shown explaining the invalid characters

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of Continue results in a single transition to overview
preconditions: User is on the Checkout - Information form
All required fields contain non-empty values
steps: 1. Click the Continue button
2. Immediately (within 1 second) click the Continue button again
test_cases.expected_result: Only one navigation to the overview step occurs; the second click is ignored or blocked by the UI. The app proceeds to the overview step once (no visible duplicate navigation or duplicate processing shown)

test_cases.test_case: Finish checkout from Overview navigates to Confirmation page
steps: 1. Open the Checkout Overview page
2. Verify the Order Summary, Totals, Payment and Shipping sections are visible
3. Click the Finish button
test_cases.expected_result: User is navigated to the Confirmation page; Checkout Overview page is no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Cancel exits checkout from Overview
steps: 1. Open the Checkout Overview page
2. Click the Cancel button
test_cases.expected_result: Checkout is exited and the Checkout Overview page is closed (Checkout Overview is no longer visible)

test_cases.test_case: Overview displays order summary, totals, payment and shipping information
steps: 1. Open the Checkout Overview page
2. Observe the Order Summary list, the Totals section, the Payment information section and the Shipping information section
test_cases.expected_result: Order Summary displays the items from <Cart>; Totals section shows 'Item total', 'Tax', and 'Total' labels; Payment information section is visible; Shipping information section is visible

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user cannot access Checkout Overview
steps: 1. As an unauthenticated user navigate to the Checkout Overview page URL
test_cases.expected_result: User is not allowed to view the Checkout Overview: the application redirects to the Login page (or shows a sign-in prompt); the overview content and the Finish button are not displayed and the user cannot complete checkout

test_cases.test_case: Finish cannot complete an order after user exits checkout with Cancel
preconditions: User has an active checkout session and is on the Checkout Overview
steps: 1. On the Checkout Overview page, click the Cancel button
2. After checkout has been exited, attempt to click the Finish button (for example by navigating back to the Overview and clicking Finish)
test_cases.expected_result: Checkout has been exited and the Finish action is blocked: the Finish button is not present or is disabled after Cancel; clicking Finish does not navigate to the confirmation page and the order is not completed

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click on Finish (duplicate submission race)
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item
User is on the Checkout - Overview step
steps: 1. Click the Finish button
2. Immediately click the Finish button again (before navigation completes)
test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds: order completion occurs and the confirmation page is displayed. Second click is blocked / error shown: no second order completion occurs and only one navigation to the confirmation page happens (user sees a single confirmation page instance).

test_cases.test_case: Browser Back after successful Finish then attempt to resubmit
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item
User is on the Checkout - Overview step
steps: 1. Click the Finish button
2. Wait until the confirmation page fully loads
3. Press the browser Back button
4. On the returned Overview page, click the Finish button again
test_cases.expected_result: Initial submit succeeds: order completion occurs and the confirmation page is displayed. Using browser Back does not create a second order; the second Finish click is blocked / error shown (no duplicate order is created) and the application prevents a second successful submission.

test_cases.test_case: Race between Finish and Cancel clicks
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item
User is on the Checkout - Overview step
steps: 1. Click the Finish button
2. Immediately click the Cancel button (before navigation to confirmation completes)
test_cases.expected_result: Finish action succeeds: order completion occurs and the confirmation page is displayed. The subsequent Cancel click is blocked / ignored and does not cancel the completed order; user remains on or is taken to the confirmation page and no cancellation occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Confirmation page shows success message and Back Home button
steps: 1. Open the Checkout - Confirmation page
2. Observe the page content
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation page displays the success message 'Thank you for your order!' and the 'Back Home' button is visible

test_cases.test_case: Clicking Back Home redirects to Product Inventory and clears the cart
steps: 1. Click the 'Back Home' button on the Confirmation page
2. Wait for navigation to complete
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to the Product Inventory page and the cart is cleared (cart displays no items / cart indicator shows empty)

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to access Confirmation page
steps: 1. Ensure the user is logged out
2. Enter the <confirmation page URL> in the browser address bar and navigate to it
test_cases.expected_result: Access is blocked: the user is redirected to the Login page and the Login page is displayed (login form visible). The Confirmation success message is NOT displayed and the cart remains unchanged.

test_cases.test_case: Direct navigation to Confirmation page without completing an order
preconditions: No order has been completed in the current session (checkout not finished)
steps: 1. Log in as a valid user
2. Navigate directly to the <confirmation page URL>
test_cases.expected_result: Access is blocked: the user is redirected to the Product Inventory page (Product Inventory page is displayed). The Confirmation success message is NOT shown and the cart is NOT cleared.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of Back Home button
preconditions: User has completed checkout and is on the Confirmation page showing the success message
steps: 1. Click the 'Back Home' button (first click)
2. Click the 'Back Home' button again immediately (second click)
test_cases.expected_result: A single navigation to Product Inventory succeeds: Product Inventory page is displayed and the cart badge shows zero; no error is shown and the UI does not produce duplicate navigations or duplicate cart-clearing side effects.

test_cases.test_case: Click Back Home then press browser Back
preconditions: User has completed checkout and is on the Confirmation page showing the success message
steps: 1. Click the 'Back Home' button
2. Press the browser Back button
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation back to the Confirmation page succeeds (if available in history): the Confirmation page displays the success message; the cart remains cleared (cart badge shows zero) and no additional order or cart entries are created.

test_cases.test_case: Verify cart cleared persists across a new tab after Back Home
preconditions: User has completed checkout and is on the Confirmation page showing the success message
steps: 1. Click the 'Back Home' button
2. Open a new browser tab and navigate to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: Product Inventory page in the new tab loads and shows the cart badge as zero, indicating the cart-clearing action succeeded and persists across tabs for the same session; original tab also shows cart badge zero.

test_cases.test_case: Confirmation message rendering with very long product name and special characters
preconditions: An order has been completed that includes an item whose name contains a very long string with special characters and emoji, and the user is on the Confirmation page
steps: 1. Observe the success message area on the Confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: The success message renders the long text and special characters without breaking page layout: text is either fully visible or properly truncated with a visible UI affordance (e.g., ellipsis/tooltip) indicating truncation; rendering of special characters and emoji succeeds and no visual overflow or layout break is shown.

test_cases.test_case: Click Logout from Inventory page redirects to Login
steps: 1. Open the Inventory page
2. Click the Logout button
test_cases.expected_result: ends session and redirects to Login page

test_cases.test_case: After logout, attempting to open Inventory page redirects to Login
steps: 1. Open any protected page (e.g., Inventory page)
2. Click the Logout button
3. Attempt to navigate to the Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Login page

test_cases.test_case: After logout, attempting to open Detail page redirects to Login
steps: 1. Open any protected page (e.g., Inventory page)
2. Click the Logout button
3. Attempt to navigate to the Detail page
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Login page

test_cases.test_case: After logout, attempting to open Cart page redirects to Login
steps: 1. Open any protected page (e.g., Inventory page)
2. Click the Logout button
3. Attempt to navigate to the Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Login page

test_cases.test_case: After logout, attempting to open Checkout page redirects to Login
steps: 1. Open any protected page (e.g., Inventory page)
2. Click the Logout button
3. Attempt to navigate to the Checkout page
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Login page

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to access a protected page (Inventory) and is blocked
steps: 1. In a new browser session (no authentication), navigate to <Inventory page URL>
test_cases.expected_result: Browser is redirected to the Login page; Inventory page content is not displayed; no authenticated session is created

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to invoke Logout action (button absent or direct endpoint) and is blocked
steps: 1. In a new browser session (no authentication), open the application header/ navigation
2. Verify whether a 'Logout' control is visible
3. Directly navigate to <Logout endpoint> (attempt to invoke logout action by URL)
test_cases.expected_result: Step 2: 'Logout' control is not visible in the header when unauthenticated. Step 3: navigating to <Logout endpoint> redirects to the Login page; no session is ended (user remains unauthenticated) and no protected content is shown

test_cases.test_case: Rapid / double-click Logout button
preconditions: User is on a protected page (Inventory_Page or Detail_Page)
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
2. Immediately click the Logout button again (second click within <1 second)
3. Observe the current page and any visible messages
test_cases.expected_result: Logout succeeds: session ends (Authenticated -> Unauthenticated) and the Login page is shown. The second click is ignored (no additional logout actions occur) and no error is shown; protected page content is not visible.

test_cases.test_case: Use browser Back after logout to access protected page
preconditions: User has previously navigated to a protected page (Inventory_Page)
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
2. After the app redirects to the Login page, press the browser Back button once
3. Observe the page shown after pressing Back
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation back to the protected page is blocked; Login page is shown (protected page content is not displayed). The user remains unauthenticated.

test_cases.test_case: Direct URL / bookmark access to protected page after logout
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
2. In the browser address bar, enter the direct URL for a protected page (Inventory_Page) and press Enter
3. Observe which page loads
test_cases.expected_result: Direct navigation to the protected page is blocked; Login page is shown instead and protected content is not visible. The user remains unauthenticated.

test_cases.test_case: Open protected page in second tab, logout in first tab, then refresh second tab
steps: 1. In Tab A, navigate to a protected page (Inventory_Page)
2. Open the same protected page in Tab B
3. In Tab A, click the Logout button
4. Switch to Tab B and click the browser Refresh/Reload button
5. Observe the page shown in Tab B after refresh
test_cases.expected_result: Refresh in Tab B is blocked from showing protected content; the Login page is shown in Tab B and the user remains unauthenticated. The state transition (Authenticated -> Unauthenticated) persists across tabs.

test_cases.test_case: Reset with items in cart clears badge and resets add/remove buttons without logging out
preconditions: At least one product in the UI shows the 'Remove' action state
steps: 1. Open the app page that contains the Reset App State button
2. Locate the 'Reset App State' button
3. Click the 'Reset App State' button
test_cases.expected_result: clears cart and resets in-app state (cart badge and add/remove button states); does not log the user out — the cart badge is no longer visible (or shows zero) and previously 'Remove' product action buttons now show 'Add'; the user's account menu/avatar remains visible indicating the user is still logged in

test_cases.test_case: Reset when cart is already empty leaves UI in default state and user remains logged in
preconditions: Product list shows 'Add' action state for items
steps: 1. Open the app page that contains the Reset App State button
2. Locate the 'Reset App State' button
3. Click the 'Reset App State' button
test_cases.expected_result: clears cart and resets in-app state (cart badge and add/remove button states); does not log the user out — the cart badge remains not visible (no change from empty), product action buttons remain in the 'Add' state, and the user's account menu/avatar remains visible indicating the user is still logged in

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to invoke Reset App State
steps: 1. Open the application page that normally contains the 'Reset App State' control
2. Click the 'Reset App State' button (if visible) or attempt to invoke the reset action
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked: the app redirects to the Login page (Login form visible) or the 'Reset App State' control is not visible/accessible to unauthenticated users; the app does not perform any reset (cart badge and add/remove button states remain unchanged).

test_cases.test_case: Reset App State must not log the user out (ensure logout side-effect is blocked)
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item
steps: 1. Sign in as a user
2. Add an item to the cart
3. Verify the cart badge shows <non-zero cart count>
4. Click the 'Reset App State' button
test_cases.expected_result: The reset action is allowed to run but the undesired logout side-effect is blocked: cart badge becomes 0 and add/remove button states reset, AND the user remains signed in (account/avatar/menu remains visible, there is no redirect to the Login page).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive clicks on Reset App State
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item (cart badge visible)
At least one product's add/remove button is in the 'Remove' state
steps: 1. Click the 'Reset App State' button
2. Immediately click the 'Reset App State' button again
test_cases.expected_result: First reset succeeds: cart contents list becomes empty and cart badge is cleared (no badge or zero displayed); add/remove buttons return to the 'Add' state. The second click is ignored (no additional state changes, no duplicate side effects, no error shown). The user remains logged in (profile/account icon still shows user and navigating to profile loads account details).

test_cases.test_case: Click Reset App State when cart is already empty
preconditions: Cart is already empty (no cart badge visible)
steps: 1. Verify cart is empty (no items listed)
2. Click the 'Reset App State' button
test_cases.expected_result: Reset action succeeds as a no-op: UI remains showing an empty cart and no cart badge; no error or warning is shown; add buttons remain in the default 'Add' state. The user remains logged in (no redirect to login).

test_cases.test_case: Reset App State then navigate to profile to verify session persistence
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item
steps: 1. Click the 'Reset App State' button
2. Click the profile/account icon or 'Profile' link to open the user's profile page
test_cases.expected_result: Reset succeeds: cart is cleared and in-app state (cart badge and add/remove buttons) is reset. Navigating to the profile page shows the user's account details and does not require re-login (user remains authenticated).
